title: Special programs bring secret technology to events without telling Skywatcher, followed by NDAs
summary: James Valor tells of Special programs bring secret technology to events without telling Skywatcher, followed by NDAs, about 2020s at US military events, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I participated in projects, and special programs brought their own secret developments on our event, not informing us.

plain: James Valor, a witness connected to the startup Skywatcher, says that in the 2020s he took part in projects with the US military. According to him, secret special programs brought their own hidden technology to the group's sky-watching events without telling them, and the participants were afterward asked to sign NDAs, non-disclosure agreements that forbid talking about what they saw. If true, some of what was seen at those events may have been secret human-made technology.
